about: Hand-kept tables for the slide links. slide_map.py copies them into slide_data.js (python3 slide_map.py --tables, no deck needed); slide_check.js checks them against the reading files.

names: [name, deck id, bare]. How running text names a deck directly before 'slide N'. bare = 1: the number may follow the name itself ('PCol 55', 'PP 8'). 'sun?' = the word Sun, shared by Dr. Smith's Exam 1 deck and Dr. Patel's Exam 2 deck: it goes to the deck of the professor named with it, else to the fourth field of the section's row, and is never guessed.

sections: [id or id prefix ending in '-', deck id or null, note, sun deck]. The deck a bare 'slide N', '(p. N)' or Slide-column number belongs to, by the section it is read in: an <h3 id> of reference.js or tell.js, a <section class=gobj id> or <h2 class=gdeck id> of guide.js, an Atlas board (at-), the practice patients of a Diseases card (dzcases-<card id>). null = the section draws on more than one deck, so a bare number there is not linked; a list of decks = a bare number is linked only where a professor named with it, or the column heading, leaves one of them. The fourth field says which deck 'Sun' means in that section ('sun' = Dr. Smith's, 'p8s' = Dr. Patel's); left out where a section sets both side by side.
notes: [deck id, clean page, text]. A line the viewer shows with that slide, for a citation whose content is not printed on the clean slide.

printed: [deck id, clean page, number]. Only for a deck cited by page (Dr. Sikazwe's): the viewer says which slide number is printed on a page and takes it to be the clean page's own place in the file, except for the rows here. Read from the clean deck with pdftotext on 2026-11-13: all 70 clean pages print their own place except page 59, which prints 51.
